dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as a single, thick, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp white longitudinal edges are visible on the folded primary and secondary feathers against a dark blue-grey base.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, oval, yellowish-white patch located on the posterior neck at the base of the crown.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Highly distinct and sharp linear boundary between the dark crown and the lighter greenish-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, prominent white auricular patch bordered by a dark cap and throat region.
